quote: Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members, and a Majority of each shall constitute a: Quorum to do Business
summary: Each House judges its own members' elections, returns, and qualifications; a majority constitutes a quorum

quote: a smaller Number may adjourn from day to day, and may be authorized to compel the Attendance of absent Members, in such Manner, and under such Penalties as each House may provide
summary: A smaller number may adjourn daily and compel absent members' attendance with specified methods and penalties
applies_to: Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members, and a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum to do Business

quote: Each House may determine the Rules of its Proceedings, punish its Members for disorderly Behaviour, and, with the Concurrence of two thirds, expel a Member
summary: Each House may set procedural rules, punish members for disorderly conduct, and expel members with two-thirds consent

quote: Each House shall keep a Journal of its Proceedings, and from time to time publish the same, excepting such Parts as may in their Judgment require Secrecy
summary: Each House keeps a journal of proceedings and publishes it, except for parts deemed secret

quote: excepting such Parts as may in their Judgment require Secrecy
summary: Parts deemed secret by the House are exempt from publication
applies_to: Each House shall keep a Journal of its Proceedings, and from time to time publish the same

quote: the Yeas and Nays of the Members of either House on any question shall, at the Desire of one fifth of those Present, be entered on the Journal
summary: Yeas and nays votes can be recorded in the journal if one-fifth of present members request

quote: Neither House, during the Session of Congress, shall, without the Consent of the other, adjourn for more than three days, nor to any other Place than that in which the two Houses shall be sitting
summary: Houses cannot adjourn beyond three days or leave the session location without the other house's consent
